# Benchmark tables

Source: <code>benchmark-summary.json</code>. SHA256: <code>f8c98b616ccc2ba67e98539cfc8a734f38c6b6dc44294b4be8303707a88ea56e</code>.

Recorded cases: **72**. Captured conversions: **2652**; timing conversions: **2220**.

Local virtual-host CLI measurements; no physical qualification or P15 certificate.

Exact no-dither signed-32 PCM output identity for every captured conversion.

Each case appears below in source order, including diagnostic repeats. A repeat is labelled with its recorded `case.repeat_of` value and remains a separate row group.

Numeric entries preserve the stored values in shortest round-trip decimal form. MAD is the median absolute deviation in the stated unit; relative MAD is MAD/median, shown as a fraction. An undefined relative MAD is labelled explicitly.

## Timing and paired comparisons

Timing statistics use the recorded timing repetitions. CPU time is child user plus system time; wall time is elapsed time. The speedup is the median paired baseline/candidate time ratio; values above 1 indicate less candidate time. It is not calculated by dividing the two arm medians.

The 95% intervals are the recorded per-case paired bootstrap intervals, **unadjusted for multiple comparisons**. They are not simultaneous family-wise confidence bounds. The paired relative MAD describes the individual paired ratios.
